title: PromptDesk
subtitle: AI-assisted CRM for freelancers
description: An AI-assisted CRM for solo freelancers and small service businesses. It manages clients, projects, time, invoices and finances, then turns that CRM data into ready-to-paste prompts for any AI tool — the app makes no LLM calls of its own. Built on Next.js and Supabase around a pure, fully tested prompt-scoring engine.
